description: Security scan of one build, read at upload from the .ipa or .apk: hardcoded secrets (only the kind, the file and a masked value, never the full key), Android backup, exported components, R8 hint, WebView debugging and user certificates, iOS App Transport Security exceptions, symbols and get-task-allow, root, jailbreak and tamper libraries, and library versions with a known advisory. Each finding has a level (block, warn, info), an OWASP MASVS category, a detail and a fix; the summary counts them ("1 to fix, 3 warnings"). Findings and hints from a static scan, not a penetration test or a certification. Builds uploaded before the scan say status unknown. Read only. Pro and Team.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

title: Security scan of a build
